# Backup Restore Procedure

Organization: Example GmbH
Version: 1.2
Review date: March 2026
Document owner: IT Operations role

## Business Continuity

Business continuity depends on documented backup restore controls for the customer portal
and finance system. The IT Operations role owns the restore procedure, tests recovery
every six months, and records the result in a restore ticket.

| System | Recovery time target | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| customer portal | four hours | restore ticket and test notes |
| finance system | one business day | backup report and owner approval |

The continuity exercise report includes failed steps, follow-up actions, and the next
review date.
